ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels (surface) to 15% low-intensity black pixels (trailing edge and base).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a contiguous high-intensity white field. A low-intensity black perimeter defines the entire trailing edge. Three distinct, roughly horizontal low-intensity linear blobs are clustered at the center-bottom near the peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression with a wide-angle vertex (estimated at 125 degrees) and minimal penetration depth relative to the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude pixel fluctuations (serrations) along the entire trailing edge, appearing most jagged at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading edge exhibits a distinct upward-sloping convexity, while the trailing edge follows a slight concave curve from the tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, dark-pigmented clusters with irregular circularity on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; scattered low-contrast grey circular spots present on the mid-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of three distinct, parallel, horizontal dark linear pixel disruptions located centrally just above the fluke-peduncle connection.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced horizontal 'rake' markings at the fluke base; irregular, rough-textured tissue loss or barnacle colonization at the extreme distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific trio of parallel horizontal scars at the ventral center is a unique high-contrast identifier for this specimen.
